This role serves as both an audit leader and subject matter expert, designing and executing audit strategies that evaluate the effectiveness of technology controls, AI governance practices, model risk management, automation frameworks, and data-driven decision-making systems. Assess generative AI and large language model (LLM) implementations, including model governance, prompt engineering controls, output validation processes, data privacy protections, and third-party AI service provider oversight. Apply data analytics, automation, and AI-assisted audit techniques to improve audit effectiveness, perform full-population testing, identify anomalies, and uncover emerging risks. Conduct walkthroughs, control assessments, testing procedures, and root cause analysis for complex technology and business processes. Communicate audit observations and recommendations through sprint reviews, stakeholder discussions, and formal audit reports. Partner with technology and business leaders to understand strategic initiatives, emerging risks, and evolving regulatory requirements. Provide coaching, mentorship, and technical guidance to audit team members in areas including technology risk, AI governance, data analytics, control evaluation, and strategic thinking. Contribute to Internal Audit transformation initiatives through the development of innovative audit methodologies, AI-enabled audit practices, continuous monitoring capabilities, and automation solutions. Maintain awareness of emerging AI regulations, industry standards, and technology trends, incorporating them into audit planning and execution. A minimum of 4 years of experience in Internal Audit, External Audit, Risk Management, Technology Risk, Cybersecurity, or Technology Control functions within a regulated or large enterprise environment. A minimum of 1 year of professional experience auditing, implementing, assessing, governing, or supporting AI, Machine Learning, Generative AI, or Advanced Analytics solutions. Practical experience with at least one analytical or technical tool such as Python, SQL, Power BI, Tableau, Alteryx, SAS, or equivalent. Proven experience presenting audit findings, risk assessments, or technology control recommendations to senior management and business stakeholders.
